title: hemerocallis fulva var. longituba
intro: Hemerocallis fulva var. longituba, commonly known as the Orange Daylily, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Hemerocallidaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Orange Daylily include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help in reducing pain and promoting ease of breathing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
